$comment: Spec 392 — THE LIVE GATES LEDGER. Every wave's live verify script, with the authority twin it carries, run nightly against faithnet by scripts/live-gates.mts. No secrets: the demo personas sign in openly and sign through the Home's persona-sign. `required` gates fail the run; the rest report. `paced` gates make model calls on a metered plan and are spaced out.

gates.proves: every model call names its provider and the numbers it was routed by; the run reads as a span tree; the reply names its provenance; a large result leaves the record for the vault
gates.twin: a route is decided before the call and recorded — a failed provider is a failure, never a re-send to another

gates.proves: a routed ask reads as two bundles joined from either side; every reply says where its provenance is; PROV-N is served
gates.twin: neither graph carries the ask's words

gates.proves: a payment's spans carry the verdict and the receipt digest; the record's provenance lands in the vault
gates.twin: no span carries the payee's address, the treasury's name or the utterance (read from the record's own result, never guessed)

gates.proves: the verified delegation chain is on the receipt: root, links, digest
gates.twin: a forged child without its parent is refused chain-parent-missing before any caveat is read

gates.proves: a step handed to a specialist runs under a child mandate cut from the parent's; the child's run is cited on the receipt
gates.twin: the same child presented for a second step is denied — single use

gates.proves: a run that stopped to ask a person resumes: the completed step replays from its receipt, the pending step is re-verified
gates.twin: a run whose window closed lists as expired and a resume is refused with that word

gates.proves: a grant revoked on chain refuses the next step
gates.twin: the revocation IS the twin: a recorded allow is never replayed as permission

gates.proves: discover → inspect → invoke through the gateway; the ministry's agent answers from its own catalog
gates.twin: the invoke posts ONLY to the endpoint the handle pinned; a changed card is said, not followed

gates.proves: every hop of the outside-in flow with its output; the run joins the gateway's W3C trace
gates.twin: the trace id correlates; the target admitted on the signed caller assertion

gates.proves: a steward raises a decision naming an approver; the named approver records it once; the detail carries the record; the approver's My Work listed it pending before and nothing after
gates.twin: a non-approver refused (403); an UN-NAMED steward refused in those words; a second record on the closed request refused (409)

gates.proves: a member's offer and the steward's allocation go through the Ask with supplied plans — the offer under the OFFERER's own mandate, the allocation under the organization's granted by its steward; the endeavor carries one allocation
gates.twin: an outsider's offer, under their own mandate, refused at the organization's member gate; a member's allocation cannot be authorized — the organization's mandate is not theirs to give

gates.proves: a standing instruction is kept from the person's yes to the read-back, listed, and fills an UNSPOKEN acting party cited `standing`; the payment still waits on its mandate
gates.twin: a spoken payer is never overridden by the instruction; once cleared, the instruction fills nothing

gates.proves: a run's anchored outcomes are readable by anyone with no session — digests and ids through the S1 firewall, the receipt digest equal to the private graph's, the transaction as the anchor
gates.twin: no address and nothing the run was about in the rows; a run with no transaction projects nothing (every step refused by name); an unknown run is 404

gates.proves: every InteractionsDO op reports its vault-call bill on its headers; the listing an organization's members open most costs what the index says, not one call per endeavor
gates.twin: advisory — the numbers are the gate; a listing that costs more than a handful of calls per viewer is the regression to read in the morning

gates.proves: a receipt's holder recomputes its digest and the agent's public projection, with no session, names the transaction anchoring it
gates.twin: a receipt changed in one field anchors nothing

gates.proves: the acting context is a namespace — a default declared while addressing an organization fills the payer there; one declared at home applies everywhere the person has not said otherwise
gates.twin: the organization's default is NOT read at home
